create.name: Sam Wysock-Wright
create.bio:
Sam Wysock-Wright is a teacher of Vedic meditation who lives in Portugal and teaches from Lisbon, with a second venue in Hampshire in England. He first sat on a beginners' course in his twenties, while working as a joiner and studying for a degree, and went on to spend several years training as a teacher in the Vedic tradition, including a long period of intensive study with a senior teacher. He founded Soma Meditation to pass the practice on in plain, everyday language rather than mystical terms.

The core of his work is a personal mantra technique practised for about twenty minutes twice a day, which he teaches face to face in Lisbon and the towns along the coast, or over video, through a short course that begins and ends with one-to-one meetings. He also leads six-night residential retreats at a country house near Lisbon that combine long meditation, gentle yoga and breathwork, and records guided meditations and affirmation practices for the Soma app and his YouTube channel, where a 21-day series looks at intention, letting go and self-trust. He teaches in English.

courses.title: Vedic Hybrid Course
courses.description: His main course for learning Vedic meditation. It opens with a private session in Lisbon or by video where you receive a personal mantra, continues with three recorded lessons over five days, and finishes with another private session when you are ready, usually within a fortnight.

courses.title: Vedic Meditation Retreat near Lisbon
courses.description: A small six-night residential retreat at a quiet quinta about forty minutes from Lisbon, built around long meditation sessions with gentle yoga, breathwork and Ayurvedic meals. Newcomers can learn the technique beforehand or during the week.

courses.title: Soma app (Base and Premium plans)
courses.description: His meditation and affirmation app, with guided sessions, a practice timer and recorded courses. The Premium plan adds the full course library and live online group sittings for Vedic meditators.

free_resources.title: An Introduction to Vedic Meditation
free_resources.description: A page with a ten-minute overview and a longer talk in which he explains how mantra-based Vedic meditation works and what a daily routine looks like.

free_resources.title: The 14-Day Affirmation Course
free_resources.description: A free two-week course in the Soma app, with seven short lessons on making affirmations personal followed by a week of guided daily practice. A free account is needed; no card is asked for.
